accommodation.step_free: Premises with step-free or lift access
accommodation.tutor: Mentor or support when starting the job
admin.intro: Each offer is reviewed before publication. Reject or remove any offer that contains a forbidden selection criterion (age, sex, origin, health, disability, family situation… — French Labour Code, article L1132-1), that asks applicants for information about their health or a disability, that promises help or a right, or whose way to apply does not lead to the employer. You never see who wrote the offer.
admin.problems: Blocks publication (the offer cannot be edited here: reject it with a reason)
admin.title: Review of job offers
closed: This feature is not open yet. It will open once its data protection impact assessment has been validated.
failed: The offers could not be loaded.
form.apply_help: Applicants write to you directly: prefer a service address rather than an employee’s personal address.
form.expires_help: At most 90 days. After this date, the offer is no longer visible.
form.text_only: Text only: no link, email address or phone number in the description (the way to apply is enough).
form.title: Job title
list.health: To apply, no information about your health or a disability is needed. If you need an accommodation, you choose whether and when to talk about it.
list.intro: Job offers published by organisations verified by the ADA team, after review. Each offer shows the accommodations the employer offers.
list.no_promise: An offer does not guarantee a job: the employer alone decides.
list.privacy: ADA does not receive your application and keeps nothing about you: you apply directly to the employer, in the way they indicate.
list.title: Inclusive job offers
pro.intro: Publish inclusive job offers. Each offer is reviewed by the ADA team before publication and stays visible until its end date. Applicants apply directly to you: ADA neither receives nor keeps any application.
pro.not_manager: Only an administrator of the organisation manages its job offers.
pro.rule_criteria: Do not state any forbidden selection criterion: age, sex, origin, nationality, health, disability, pregnancy, family situation, religion, appearance, place of residence… (French Labour Code, article L1132-1).
pro.rule_health: Never ask applicants for information about their health or a disability. Describe the accommodations you offer instead.
pro.saved: Draft saved. Send it for review when it is ready.
pro.title: Job offers of the organisation
pro.unavailable: Job offers are not available on this service.
problem.accommodation: Tick at least one accommodation offered.
problem.apply_target: Incorrect application address: a web address starting with https:// or an email address.
problem.city: Enter the town of the job.
problem.contact: No link, email address or phone number in the text: the way to apply is enough.
problem.entitlement: Do not promise a right or help: rephrase.
problem.expiry_far: The end date cannot be more than 90 days away.
problem.expiry_past: The end date must be after today.
problem.forbidden: An offer may not contain any forbidden selection criterion (French Labour Code, article L1132-1).
problem.markup: No image or formatting: text only.
problem.not_verified: Only an active organisation verified by the ADA team can publish an offer.
problem.title: Enter the job title (at least 5 characters).
reason.discriminatory: Forbidden selection criterion (French Labour Code, article L1132-1)
reason.health_data: Asks for information about health or a disability
reason.not_job: This is not a job offer
